# Entering Models

### Low Entering Model

```{r}
enter_fit_low <- lmer(RdNBR ~ Type * Point_Num + (1|Incid_Name/Transect_ID), data = enter_df_low, REML = TRUE)
   
tab_model(enter_fit_low)

# Residual diagnostic plots for m1
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

# Q-Q plot
qqnorm(resid(enter_fit_low), main = "Q-Q Plot of Residuals")
qqline(resid(enter_fit_low), col = "red")

# Residuals vs Fitted
plot(fitted(enter_fit_low), resid(enter_fit_low),
     xlab = "Fitted Values",
     ylab = "Residuals",
     main = "Residuals vs Fitted")
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

### Entering Effect

##Try a Figure with Point_Num

```{r}
# Predictions across all 10 points, for control vs entering
get_pred <- function(fit, sev) {
  ggpredict(fit, terms = c("Point_Num", "Type")) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(severity = sev,
           x = as.numeric(as.character(x)))
}

pred_pts <- bind_rows(
  get_pred(enter_fit_low,  "Low"),
  get_pred(enter_fit_mod,  "Moderate"),
  get_pred(enter_fit_high, "High")
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(predicted)) %>%
  mutate(severity = factor(severity, levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")))

get_diff <- function(fit, sev) {
  emm <- emmeans::emmeans(fit, ~ Type | Point_Num)
  emmeans::contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise") %>%   # entering - control
    confint() %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(severity  = sev,
           Point_Num = as.numeric(as.character(Point_Num)))
}

diff_all <- bind_rows(
  get_diff(enter_fit_low,  "Low"),
  get_diff(enter_fit_mod,  "Moderate"),
  get_diff(enter_fit_high, "High")
) %>%
  mutate(severity = factor(severity, levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")),
         Zone = if_else(Point_Num <= 5, "Outside Treatment", "Inside Treatment")) 

# Annotation data: High facet only, with matching factor levels
high_df <- data.frame(
  severity = factor("High", levels = levels(diff_all$severity))
)

# Named vector: c("old_value" = "New Title")
custom_titles <- c("High" = "High Starting Sev.", "Moderate" = "Moderate Starting Sev.", "Low" = "Low Starting Sev.")

#Labeling 50m
bracket_y = -475

fig1 <- ggplot(diff_all, aes(x = Point_Num, y = estimate)) +
  # Background highlight for the treatment zone
  annotate("rect", xmin = 5.5, xmax = 10.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           alpha = 0.08, fill = "blue") +

  # Reference lines
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +

  # Main plot layers
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
                width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +

  # --- High facet only text etc. ---
  geom_text(data = high_df,
            aes(x = 8, y = 225, label = "Treatment \nZone"),
            size = 8, color = "blue", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  # # Horizontal span line
  # geom_segment(data = high_df,
  #              aes(x = 1, y = -475, xend = 2, yend = -475),
  #              linewidth = 0.5, color = "blue", 
  #              arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm"), 
  #                            type = "closed", ends = "both"),
  #            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # # "50m" label centered under the bracket
  # geom_text(data = high_df,
  #           aes(x = 1.5, y = -440, label = "50m"),
  #           size = 8, color = "blue", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  ### - end High only - ###
  # Scales & Facets
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  facet_wrap(~severity, labeller = as_labeller(custom_titles), 
             nrow = 1) +

  # Labels & Theme
  labs(x = "Transect Point",
       y = "RdNBR Difference") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 28),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 28),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 28),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 28),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 28))
fig1

ggsave(
  filename = "documents/figures/Entering_Effect.png",
  plot     = fig1,
  width    = 20,
  height   = 7,
  units    = "in",
  dpi      = 300
)
```

### exiting Effect

##Try a Figure with Point_Num

```{r}
# Predictions across all 10 points, for control vs exiting
get_pred <- function(fit, sev) {
  ggpredict(fit, terms = c("Point_Num", "Type")) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(severity = sev,
           x = as.numeric(as.character(x)))
}

pred_pts <- bind_rows(
  get_pred(exit_fit_low,  "Low"),
  get_pred(exit_fit_mod,  "Moderate"),
  get_pred(exit_fit_high, "High")
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(predicted)) %>%
  mutate(severity = factor(severity, levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")))

get_diff <- function(fit, sev) {
  emm <- emmeans::emmeans(fit, ~ Type | Point_Num)
  emmeans::contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise") %>%   # exiting - control
    confint() %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(severity  = sev,
           Point_Num = as.numeric(as.character(Point_Num)))
}

diff_all <- bind_rows(
  get_diff(exit_fit_low,  "Low"),
  get_diff(exit_fit_mod,  "Moderate"),
  get_diff(exit_fit_high, "High")
) %>%
  mutate(severity = factor(severity, levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")),
         Zone = if_else(Point_Num <= 5, "Outside Treatment", "Inside Treatment")) 

# Annotation data: High facet only, with matching factor levels
high_df <- data.frame(
  severity = factor("High", levels = levels(diff_all$severity))
)

# Named vector: c("old_value" = "New Title")
custom_titles <- c("High" = "High Starting Sev.", "Moderate" = "Moderate Starting Sev.", "Low" = "Low Starting Sev.")

#Labeling 50m
bracket_y = -475

fig1 <- ggplot(diff_all, aes(x = Point_Num, y = estimate)) +
  # Background highlight for the treatment zone
  annotate("rect", xmin = 5.5, xmax = 10.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           alpha = 0.08, fill = "blue") +

  # Reference lines
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +

  # Main plot layers
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
                width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +

  # --- High facet only text etc. ---
  geom_text(data = high_df,
            aes(x = 8, y = 225, label = "Treatment \nZone"),
            size = 8, color = "blue", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  # Horizontal span line
  geom_segment(data = high_df,
               aes(x = 1, y = -475, xend = 2, yend = -475),
               linewidth = 0.5, color = "blue", 
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm"), 
                             type = "closed", ends = "both"),
             inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # "50m" label cexited under the bracket
  geom_text(data = high_df,
            aes(x = 1.5, y = -440, label = "50m"),
            size = 8, color = "blue", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  ### - end High only - ###
  # Scales & Facets
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  facet_wrap(~severity, labeller = as_labeller(custom_titles), 
             nrow = 1) +

  # Labels & Theme
  labs(x = "Transect Point",
       y = "RdNBR Difference") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 28),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 28),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 28),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 28),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 28, hjust = 0))
fig1

ggsave(
  filename = "documents/figures/exiting_Effect.png",
  plot     = fig1,
  width    = 20,
  height   = 7,
  units    = "in",
  dpi      = 300
)
```
